newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia may ask Gaz de France to firm sale.
newsitem.headline: Latvia may ask Gaz de France to firm sale.

text.p: Latvia may invite French state-owned Gaz de France to take part in the privatisation of its national gas company if German Ruhrgas pulls out of the deal, the head of the privatisation agency said on Friday.
Ruhrgas and Preussen formed a consortium to buy a stake in Latvian Gas with Russia's Gazprom as a separate partner but the German firms want Latvia to guarantee Latvian Gas debts.
Latvia has proposed to guarantee some of the debts but not all. Ruhrgas is due to decide today (Friday) on whether to proceed with the deal, privatisation agency head Janis Naglis told Reuters.
"If Ruhrgas rejects the Latvian proposals then we will immediately invite Gaz de France to take part in the privatisation of Latvian Gas, Naglis added.
He noted that Gaz de France vice-president George Donard was recently in Riga and had expressed the company's interest in being part of the privatisation.
